headline: The problem AI content moderation cannot solve

story_facts.headline: The problem AI content moderation cannot solve
story_facts.plain_language_summary: Meta and other big tech companies are increasingly using AI for content moderation, but as the backlash to Muse Image shows, it cannot protect users because it does not account for consent.
